integrity: The proof is an exhaustive analytic partition of clique-label regimes, and the packaged checker directly tests the defining double Roman conditions on small complete split graphs. Literature comparisons distinguish the prior scalar results from the all-function enumerator.
scientific_limitations: The formula is proved for r,n>=2. Boundary cases r=1 or n=1 are excluded. Exhaustive computation checks only 2<=r,n<=4 and is not used as the all-orders proof. The scalar minimum value is prior-covered; originality is claimed only for the all-weight enumerator and exact counts. Poorly indexed equivalent literature remains a residual risk.
title: Double Roman weight enumerator of complete split graphs
